approach: Replace the trailer rule in land::pr_commits with content classification. For each commit in remote_base..head (oldest first), build Change::of_commit and Judged::new from athena-gate, then: (1) closing_jobs (made `pub` in invariant.rs, unchanged logic) non-empty → job_landing, after requiring exactly one job, a verification record and a landed outcome in the commit's tree (JobFiles::load; outcome.json or outcome-landed.json); (2) else if the diff adds records/interventions/<month>/<id>.json with a valid id whose month matches → declared_intervention (no job/verification); (3) else if fingerprint(tree; parent rules) equals the parent's fingerprint → records_only (this covers records and owner-path files); (4) else error naming the sha. PrCommit gains `kind` and optional `job`/`verification`; gh.rs GitLandingRecords::commits copies them into LandingCommit, so job_ids in the intent come only from job_landing commits. Fixtures in gh.rs, reconcile.rs and the CLI reconcile test are rewritten to follow the content rules (real closing records, or a records-only owner-path commit) rather than loosening the code. run.rs retry_landing and the nonexistent drain.rs are audited, not changed unless the audit finds a dependency.

decisions.choice: Reuse athena_gate::invariant::closing_jobs by making it pub; call it per commit with Change::of_commit and Judged::new.
decisions.reason: One source of truth for 'which job's closing records does this commit add', including the blocked-job exclusion, so blocked-then-landed works with no new logic.

rejected.option: Re-implement the closing-path scan in land.rs
rejected.why: Two copies would drift; the request and user default say to reuse.
It checks prediction ordering, invocation reconciliation and fingerprints; pr_commits only needs classification, and that check already ran at commit time in the gate.

decisions.choice: Any commit with a non-empty closing_jobs is job_landing, whether or not its fingerprint changed. More than one closing job in a commit is an error naming the sha. A missing verification, or a recorded outcome that is not landed, is an error naming the sha.
decisions.reason: A LandingCommit carries one job and one verification, so a chain squash cannot be represented, and a job record set that cannot be backed by a verification must not be written. closing_jobs already drops jobs whose outcome is recorded as not landed, so the 'outcome not landed' case is refused by the governed-change rule when it carries governed work. The explicit outcome check covers the case of no outcome record at all.

rejected.option: Require a fingerprint change for job_landing
rejected.why: A landed job with an empty change would then be misclassified as records_only, losing the job.
Violates the existing contract that nothing is recorded for commits nothing verified.

decisions.choice: Verification id comes from the existing verification_id(job, sha) (the job's id), read only after confirming JobFiles.verification exists in the commit's tree.
decisions.reason: Matches §5.3: one verification per job, named by the job id. In blocked-then-landed the verification is in the tree from the earlier commit, so the later commit still resolves.

rejected.option: Require the verification file to be added by the same commit
rejected.why: Fails the blocked-then-landed case the criteria require.

decisions.choice: Declared intervention is recognised by an added path records/interventions/<month>/<id>.json with a valid RecordId whose month matches; no trailer is read.
decisions.reason: Content-based, and the same path rule as gate invariant::intervention, which only adds the trailer name on top.

rejected.why: The request is to stop reading trailers.

decisions.choice: Fixtures: gh.rs and reconcile.rs World/pr_head commits add a real landed job (candidate, verification, outcome JSON plus governed work) via a #[cfg(test)] pub(crate) helper in land.rs. The CLI test makes its PR commit a records-only commit under an owner directory whose .gitattributes (committed to main in the base) holds '* athena-exclude'.
decisions.reason: The code is correct to refuse trailer-only commits, so the fixtures change. The CLI test cannot reach a cfg(test) helper of the lib, and it only needs pr_commits to succeed; a records-only commit does that without building record JSON.

rejected.option: Keep trailer-only fixtures and add a fallback in pr_commits
rejected.why: Reintroduces the trailer rule the request removes.

decisions.choice: Do not create drain.rs. Audit run.rs retry_landing, which writes the blocked job's landing commit with outcome-landed.json; it does not call pr_commits, so it is left unchanged unless a test shows otherwise. Say so in the change description.
decisions.reason: drain.rs does not exist in the snapshot. The brief says to change run.rs and drain.rs only if they depend on the classification.

rejected.option: Edit run.rs trailer code to match
rejected.why: It writes commits with trailers for the gate's hints; it neither reads nor depends on pr_commits.

files.purpose: Make closing_jobs pub, with its doc comment saying it is shared with athena-core's pr_commits. No change in behavior.

Rewrite PrCommit (sha, tree, kind, job, verification) and pr_commits with content classification and sha-bearing errors. Remove the trailer-count tests. Add the new tests and a #[cfg(test)] pub(crate) fixture helper that writes a job's records into a repo.

GitLandingRecords::commits maps PrCommit's kind/job/verification into LandingCommit. Update the land_pr test World to commit real closing records. Update the doc comments that say the PR commits need a verification.
Test World::pr_head commits a real landed job instead of an Athena-Job trailer.
The PR commit becomes a records-only owner-directory commit (nested .gitattributes in the base) instead of an Athena-Job trailer commit.
Audit only. Edit only if retry_landing's commit is found to depend on pr_commits; expected no change.
§5.3: describe content-based classification and closing_jobs as the single source; remove the trailer rule.
Record the change under the unreleased section: content-based classification, fixtures updated.

steps: Make `closing_jobs` pub in crates/athena-gate/src/invariant.rs and update its doc comment. Check that `athena_gate::jobs::JobFiles` and `athena_gate::{Change, Judged}` are reachable from athena-core.

In land.rs, change PrCommit to { sha, tree, kind: LandingKind, job: Option<JobId>, verification: Option<RecordId> }. Rewrite pr_commits: rev-list oldest first; per commit build Change::of_commit and Judged::new, then apply rules 1-4 from the approach; every error names the sha, the base and the head; an empty range stays an error. Write doc comments for outside readers on the content rules and closing_jobs as the single source. Do not read trailers.

In land.rs tests, delete the trailer-count tests (if any exist for pr_commits) and add: the fixture helper (repo with the nested owner directory, record writers for reading/dispatch/introspection/intervention/candidate/verification/outcome(s)), the realistic range, blocked-then-landed, the four refusals, and the empty range. Leave the resync tests as they are.

In gh.rs, update GitLandingRecords::commits to copy kind/job/verification from PrCommit (drop the unconditional JobLanding and verification_id call from the mapping). Compute the intent's job_ids from job_landing commits. Update docs. Update the land_pr test World (initial and add_commit) to commit real closing records plus governed work, and add a records-only-commit test that checks the landing's kinds and validate().
In reconcile.rs tests, change World::pr_head to commit a landed job via the land.rs helper (pr number set per job id), and check the 5 reconcile tests.

In athena-cli/tests/reconcile.rs, commit owner-notes/.gitattributes ('* athena-exclude') on main before the push, then make the pr1 commit add owner-notes/pr1.txt with no trailer. Update the comments.
Audit run.rs retry_landing and the other Athena-Job uses in run.rs; confirm none call pr_commits; change nothing unless one does. Note that drain.rs is absent.

Run cargo test -p athena-core land::, gh::, cargo test -p athena-core, cargo test -p athena-cli --test reconcile, cargo test --locked, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings, cargo fmt --all --check. Write the change description listing every caller and writer of landing records with its covering test, whether fixtures or code changed and why, and the commands actually run.

risks.risk: Fixture records that do not parse, or sit off the canonical path, are silently dropped by JobFiles::load, so a landing looks like records_only or an error.
risks.mitigation: Give the shared fixture helper well-formed records (copied from athena-gate landing_tests constructors) and assert via JobFiles::load that the job loads before relying on it; AnyRecord::parse plus the canonical-path check are what closing_jobs depends on.

risks.risk: closing_jobs requires the exact path records/jobs/<month>/<id>/<name> and status 'A'.
risks.mitigation: Build the full path from JobId::dir() in the fixture. Keep an explicit test (blocked-then-landed) that proves closing_jobs works from outcome-landed.json alone.

risks.risk: Cost: Judged::new loads the config and classifies for every commit in a long range.
risks.mitigation: Judged::new and the classification run once per commit using git plumbing already used by the gate. Ranges are PR-sized.

risks.risk: The boundary scan bans a word, and a doc comment naming the exclusion could trip it.
risks.mitigation: The owner-path tests use the directory name owner-notes and put the exclusion in the base commit; the doc comment names the pattern without the banned word. Run the full cargo test --locked to catch the scan.

risks.risk: Other tests in athena-core or athena-cli that reach pr_commits through land_pr (e.g. in gh.rs) still use trailer-only commits.
risks.mitigation: Run the whole suite; grep for pr_commits and GitLandingRecords before finishing; the plan lists every caller found by grep.

demonstrations.method: Unit test in land.rs tests: build a repo, commit the nested owner-directory .gitattributes ('* athena-exclude', named in the doc comment) into the base, then commit reading, dispatch, introspection records, an owner-path file, an intervention record, then a job's candidate/verification/outcome with governed work, all without trailers. Call pr_commits(base, head).
demonstrations.observes: Kinds are [RecordsOnly x4, DeclaredIntervention, JobLanding]; the last has job == the fixture job and verification == RecordId of that job; every PrCommit's LandingCommit passes validate.
demonstrations.fails_without: With the trailer rule, every commit in the range lacks an Athena-Job trailer and pr_commits errors; with a wrong classification the asserted kinds (records_only x4, declared_intervention, job_landing) differ.

demonstrations.method: Unit test: commit 1 adds candidate, verification and a blocked outcome; commit 2 adds only outcome-landed.json (after_blocked) plus a governed file.
demonstrations.observes: Commit 1 is RecordsOnly with no job; commit 2 is JobLanding for that job with the job's verification id.
demonstrations.fails_without: If closing_jobs were not reused, the blocked commit would not be recognised as records_only, or the outcome-landed-only commit would not map to its job.

demonstrations.method: Four unit tests, each building one bad commit and asserting pr_commits returns Err whose text contains the commit sha: (a) governed change with no intervention record and no closing records; (b) landing records with no verification; (c) governed change with an outcome recorded as rejected (not landed); (d) a file under the owner directory when the nested exclusion is absent.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the refusals, these ranges would classify (or be recorded) as landings or records, and no error would contain the sha.

demonstrations.method: Run both test commands in full, as separate whole commands.
demonstrations.command: cargo test -p athena-core && cargo test -p athena-cli --test reconcile
demonstrations.observes: All tests pass, including reconcile::tests (5) and the CLI status/land unattributed tests (2). The change description says the fixtures changed and why.
demonstrations.fails_without: Before the change the 5 core reconcile tests and the 2 CLI reconcile tests fail on their trailer-only fixtures. They pass only if the fixtures carry real closing records, or a records-only commit in the CLI case.

demonstrations.method: gh.rs land_pr tests (the world builds a real landed-job commit). The existing assertion on landing.commits is kept, and a test with a records-only commit in the range asserts the landing's kind is RecordsOnly with no job.
demonstrations.observes: landing.commits equals the expected LandingCommit(s) with kind, job and verification from pr_commits; each calls validate().unwrap(); intent.job_ids lists only job_landing jobs.
demonstrations.fails_without: If kind/job/verification were not taken from pr_commits, the landing record would still say JobLanding for records-only commits, or would fail validate.

demonstrations.method: The tests above run trailerless. A unit test calls pr_commits(base, base) and asserts Err containing 'adds no commit'. The producer reads the final land.rs to confirm the doc comments of PrCommit and pr_commits state the content rules and that closing_jobs is the single source, and that the old trailer-count tests and the string 'Athena-Job' no longer appear in pr_commits or PrCommit. Note: the unrelated resync tests in land.rs still use Athena-Job in commit messages and are left as they are.
demonstrations.observes: Empty-range error text; no trailers() call inside pr_commits; the doc comments.
demonstrations.fails_without: A leftover trailer read would make the trailerless tests in criteria 1-3 error. The empty-range test fails if the empty-range error is dropped.

demonstrations.method: Inspect the change description (the producer's final report) against the callers found by grep: gh.rs GitLandingRecords::commits (intent, landing, write_landing), reconcile.rs via GitLandingRecords::write_landing, athena-cli/tests/reconcile.rs via intent(), run.rs retry_landing (audited, unchanged, covered by its existing retry tests), drain.rs (absent).
demonstrations.observes: The description lists each caller and writer with its test and cites the cargo commands actually run with their results.

demonstrations.method: Read the diff of docs/design/records-history.md (§5.3 and any other trailer-rule text) and CHANGELOG.md.
demonstrations.observes: The docs describe records_only / declared_intervention / job_landing by content and closing_jobs; the 'exactly one Athena-Job trailer' rule is gone. A CHANGELOG entry under the unreleased heading says the same.

demonstrations.method: Run clippy and fmt as separate whole commands (the brief lists `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check`).
demonstrations.observes: Both exit 0 with no warnings or diffs.

open_questions: drain.rs does not exist in the base snapshot, though it is listed as a deliverable; the plan does not create it. Confirm that is acceptable.

Whether a nested .gitattributes added in the same commit as an owner-path file counts as excluded: classification uses the parent's rules, so the fixtures commit the .gitattributes in the base. Not run.
Whether `Judged::new` and closing_jobs behave on merge commits in the range (first-parent diff); not exercised by the brief's cases. The producer should add one merge-commit case if cheap.

A commit that adds only a candidate (no outcome yet) is refused as a job landing without a landed outcome. If Athena ever writes candidate records in a separate commit, this needs a second look; the gate's own rule is that closing records arrive together.
